speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The heads, and then one turning. No unlawful assembly in or about the City. Martial law, if it is broken. Sir Thomas Wilford to see it done. Given at Greenwich, this fourth of July.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I will not keep you past the glass. A short sermon frightens a parish that came prepared to endure. Sit with what was read.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He has stopped. I am glad, and I do not like that I am glad.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Mayor's pew has halberds at the door of it. There is a new man standing behind.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Do not make me the woman who says whose pew is guarded. I can see the steel from here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The north aisle. One pew is empty. The household with the dark head is not in it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You may look once. You may not invite a pew to dinner.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: I will not give an empty seat a place in the sermon. The proclamation was the word. The glass is done.

speaker: (a neighbour)
text: Half the better sort have gone out of the City till the streets are quiet.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: She may say that. I will not say which houses. Gone is gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have lost nothing.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And you have the look of a man who has been robbed of a thing he never held. Come out of the aisle.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not going to mark it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Mark a day you were told to mark, and not a hope. The sheet on the gate is enough print for one week.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No cross. The mark is for a day I see her, or hear her. This is a day I looked.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the book stays clean, and so does my table. We are going home when the porch allows it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: A hungry crowd and a wicked crowd are not the same creature. The proclamation does not say so. I have said so. Remember which voice was which.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will remember the glass, sir. One turn. They heard it because it was short.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I want my dinner before the heat sits on the stair. I am not measuring the close to get it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sir John gave the responses, and nothing further. Short, and cold. That is all I am taking from his pew.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Leave the new man where he is standing. He is not coming to the house.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Go home within the parish. The heads have been read. I have no second glass for you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Within the parish. Yes.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: One look. The dinner is real. We are finished with the pew.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: God keep this parish quieter than its news. I have nothing else.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing else from me, sir. No mark. No second meaning put on an empty board.
